closes.note: fix-51 (Order 51): JS reads a wrapped scalar view's payload out wherever the option is consumed (unwrap_or, map, is_some, a let, an is capture, a ! lift, a list of options, an Option<&str> parameter); the premise was narrower than the bug (every value consumer, scalar fields, Option<&mut T>, literal match legs); commit b868dca0; both backends pinned

fix-51 (Order 51): & of a call result (and of a value if/match/block) gets its own one-slot cell where the pointee is a scalar; a call returning a view is re-borrowed as itself; not specific to generic &T (a concrete &usize threw too); commits af7569fb + c98db578

fix-51 (Order 51): the trait-object vtable is a keyed emission in the const world, so const evaluation dispatches through dyn; a dyn const RESULT and Json/Wire derives over a dyn member are refused by name (dyn_member_derive_refusal beside B117's); spec/const.md §9.4 + std/encoding.md; commit 8a38a905

fix-51 (Order 51): the const interpreter answers indexOf/lastIndexOf in UTF-16 units (-1 absent; empty needle at 0 and at the length); a census pin evaluates every str method std declares at expansion time against its runtime answer; commit 8d43b8a1

fix-51 (Order 51): a macro fun inside an inline mod is registered under its mod-qualified name, looked up innermost-outward; a name defined in two mods of one file is refused by name; spec §10.1; commit 980ac416; G29 filed for export inside a mod
fix-51 (Order 51): [derive(Storable)] without its import now steers to the import line (was 'a compiler load-ordering bug'); commit 102b5f90; filed and fixed in the same hand-back
